backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing user profiles, stories with 24h expiry, studies with materials and participants, following relationships, and access control with admin permissions. Includes blob storage and authorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features for media post deletion: delete button UI, confirmation dialog, immediate UI removal, and mutation hook with backend integration.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration files, with detailed descriptions of functionality and recent changes like delete post feature and profile setup flow.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme color schemes using oklch color space, including sidebar, chart, and destructive color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Santal Connect app with viewport meta tag and module script loading the React application from main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component with TanStack Router setup, Internet Identity authentication gating, and route definitions for all pages including feed, posts, reels, messages, profile, admin, and learning sections.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAllUs: Admin panel component displaying a placeholder message indicating user listing functionality is unavailable, directing admins to use search instead.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminUserC: Admin panel component for viewing read-only conversation history of a specific user, showing conversation list and individual message threads with navigation between views.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminUserM: Admin panel component for moderating individual users, allowing admins to toggle verification status, grant/revoke teacher badges, and ban/unban users with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminUsers: Main admin users management interface with tabs for searching users by display name and viewing all users, allowing selection of individual users to view their moderation panel and conversations.
frontend/src/components/admin/RequireAdm: Higher-order component that checks if the current user has admin privileges and displays an access denied message if not, showing a loading spinner during verification.
Login page component that displays the app branding and provides Internet Identity authentication with error handling and loading states.
frontend/src/components/common/TeacherBa: Reusable badge component that displays a red circular icon with a book symbol to indicate teacher status.
frontend/src/components/common/VerifiedA: Avatar component that displays user profile pictures with optional verified and teacher badge overlays positioned at the corners.
frontend/src/components/common/VerifiedB: Reusable badge component that displays a blue circular icon with a checkmark to indicate verified status.
frontend/src/components/events/EventForm: Form component for creating events with fields for name, date/time, location, and description, including validation and submission handling.
frontend/src/components/feed/UserSearchR: Panel component that displays user search results in a card format with clickable user entries that navigate to profile pages, including loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout component with sticky header (logo, app name, add story button, profile menu, logout), main content area, bottom navigation for mobile, and footer with branding. Manages authentication state and story dialog.
frontend/src/components/layout/BottomNav: Fixed bottom navigation bar for mobile with icons and labels for Feed, Reels, Messages, Explore, Learn, Events, and conditionally Admin (if user is admin). Highlights active route.
frontend/src/components/learn/DailyItemC: Card component displaying a daily word with title and content, styled with gradient background and sparkles icon. Uses UnicodeText for proper text rendering.
frontend/src/components/learn/LearnCreat: Dialog for admins to create new lessons with title and content fields. Handles form submission, validation, and calls useAdminAddLesson mutation with success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/messages/Sticker: Displays a sticker by ID using CSS sprite positioning from a sticker sheet image. Supports small, medium, and large sizes.
Popover component with a grid of stickers from the sticker sheet. Allows users to select a sticker which triggers onStickerSelect callback.
frontend/src/components/posts/CommentsPa: Displays a scrollable list of comments with author avatars and names, plus a form to add new comments. Each comment item links to the author's profile.
frontend/src/components/posts/DeletePost: Alert dialog for confirming post deletion with loading state. Calls useDeletePost mutation and shows success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/posts/PostCard.t: Card component displaying a post with author info (avatar, name, verified/teacher badges), media (image/video), content text, like/comment actions, and optional delete button. Includes expandable comments panel and handles like/unlike mutations.
frontend/src/components/posts/UnicodeTex: Simple wrapper component for rendering text with proper Unicode support, whitespace preservation, and word breaking using system fonts.
frontend/src/components/profile/AvatarUp: Component for uploading and displaying user avatars with file validation (image type, 5MB limit), upload progress tracking, and integration with ExternalBlob for backend storage.
frontend/src/components/profile/CountryC: Select dropdown component for choosing country calling codes from a predefined list of 29 countries, used for phone number input in profile forms.
frontend/src/components/profile/Follower: Modal dialog that displays a scrollable list of followers or following users with avatars and profile information, allowing navigation to user profiles on click.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Dropdown menu component showing the current user's avatar and display name with navigation options to view/edit profile and access followers/following lists.
frontend/src/components/stories/AddStory: Dialog for creating 24-hour stories with image upload, file validation, preview, and upload progress tracking using ExternalBlob integration.
frontend/src/components/stories/StoriesR: Horizontal scrollable row displaying story circles grouped by author, with the current user's "Add Story" button first, followed by followed users' stories with unviewed indicators.
frontend/src/components/stories/StoryVie: Full-screen modal for viewing stories with tap navigation (left/right zones), progress indicators, author profile header, and support for image/video media types.
frontend/src/config/brand.ts: Defines the application branding constants including app name ('Santal Connect'), tagline, and description for the Santal culture community platform.
frontend/src/config/featuredCreators.ts: Exports an allowlist of featured creator principal IDs and a helper function to check if a principal is featured; intended as a temporary solution until backend curation is available.
frontend/src/config/highlights.ts: Defines curated highlight channel categories (Festivals, Folklore, Dance & Music, Art & Nature) with metadata like icons and descriptions, plus a ChannelId type.
frontend/src/config/stickers.ts: Defines culturally themed sticker items with sprite sheet positions (3x2 grid layout) and the path to the sticker sheet image for messaging features.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/usePasswordActor.ts: Empty file, likely a placeholder for password-based actor authentication functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/usePasswordAuth.tsx: Empty file, likely a placeholder for password-based authentication hooks or context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including user profiles, posts, conversations, lessons, events, stories, and admin operations with error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useReelsAutoplay.ts: Custom hook using IntersectionObserver to track which reel is currently visible (75% threshold) in a scrollable container and return the active index.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom earth-tone color palette for light and dark modes, including CSS variables for UI components and Unicode font support for Ol Chiki script.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabs for managing events, lessons, channel content, and users; includes forms for creating events/lessons and assigning posts to channels, wrapped in RequireAdmin guard.
frontend/src/pages/ChannelPage.tsx: Displays posts for a specific highlight channel with channel metadata, back navigation, and a create button for authenticated users; shows loading state and empty state when appropriate.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Chat interface page that displays a conversation with another user, supports text messages and sticker selection, and includes real-time message scrolling and user profile display.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Post creation page that allows users to upload images/videos with captions, optionally associate posts with events or highlight channels, and displays upload progress.
frontend/src/pages/CreateReelsPage.tsx: Dedicated page for creating video reels with caption support, video file validation (max 100MB), and upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/pages/EventDetailsPage.tsx: Event details page that displays event information (date, location, description) and associated posts, with the ability for authenticated users to create event-specific posts.
frontend/src/pages/EventsPage.tsx: Events listing page that shows all community events with upcoming/past indicators, and allows admin users to create new events via a dialog form.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Main feed page displaying posts, stories row, and user search functionality. Includes authenticated actions like creating posts/reels and viewing stories.
frontend/src/pages/HighlightsPage.tsx: Displays curated community highlight channels celebrating Santal culture with navigation to channel details and local talent showcase.
frontend/src/pages/LearnPage.tsx: Learning corner for Ol Chiki/Santali language with daily items and mini lessons. Admins and users with teacher badges can create content.
frontend/src/pages/LessonPage.tsx: Individual lesson detail page displaying title, content, and optional media for a specific Santali language lesson.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Messages page placeholder showing empty state with prompt to start conversations from user profiles. Requires authentication.
frontend/src/pages/ProfileEditPage.tsx: Profile editing form with avatar upload, display name, bio, location, phone validation, and country code selection. Includes admin avatar application feature.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page displaying avatar, bio, location, posts, and follow/follower counts. Supports follow/unfollow actions, messaging, and private field visibility for admins/owners.
frontend/src/pages/ReelsPage.tsx: Displays a vertical scrolling feed of video posts (reels) with autoplay, mute toggle, author info, and engagement stats (likes/comments). Uses snap scrolling for TikTok-style navigation.
frontend/src/pages/ShowcasePage.tsx: Displays a grid of featured creators from the Santal community, filtering posts by featured status and showing creator cards with navigation to their profiles.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrors.ts: Normalizes backend error messages into user-friendly English text, handling common patterns like unauthorized access, profile requirements, and follow/like state errors.
frontend/src/utils/phoneValidation.ts: Validates and normalizes phone numbers, checking for digit-only content and length constraints (7-15 digits).
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH, extended theme settings, animations, and plugins for typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking existing and pending features for a media management application, including delete functionality for user-uploaded photos and videos.
